row:
Our objective is to publish educational content on physiotherapy for our peers and students; lifestyle improvement content for aiding the common man in daily life and rehabilitation related content aiding patients. 

We are grateful for every new subscriber!

--------
Disclaimer: The content shared on this channel does not constitute medical advice in any form. The content here is intended to cater to our peers, students and the common man. If you are a patient, please seek advice from health care professionals.
